scope: External author source only; no importer, constitutive F/T, tensor consumer, solver, HP, constructor, tests or plotting executed by this review

reverse_only: mechanical availability constant and per-state metadata check
material_energy shape removed (17 to16); force-field error label

reference_scope.fresh_HP: 80 and120 for every actual accepted state, including genuine bisections; 2*N
reference_scope.local_and_global_three_force_and_one_dir: Original unchanged full coverage and scale/floor rules
reference_scope.energy: Absent candidate field; analytic HP energy remains raw archive only, unqualified
reference_scope.stress: Finite saved stress required; no independent stress HP qualification

observer_contract.force: Original strict base/trial accounting; only recorded range rejection immediately followed by half factor may explain incomplete F
observer_contract.tangent: All T starts/completions/Newton history must agree; observed local returns and API CSC completions equal on admitted success
observer_contract.first_tangent_range_input: Must be None and directory absent for this unchanged all-T-complete reference precondition
observer_contract.first_tangent_output: Not part of producer contract; not required by loader
observer_contract.restoration: Both force/tangent same original function instances
observer_contract.observation_calls_are_transparent: Original force tuple and tangent dict returned; same errors bare-rethrown; no extra evaluation

restrictions: No qualification before fresh successful production and full new reference run
A recovered incomplete tangent/CSC evaluation is not automatically admitted; requires a separate explicit accounting decision
Rejected range trial input remains diagnostic only, not independently qualified
No transferred old rejected-state, failed-cycle, auxiliary-energy, T25, H2/H3, HF5, pressure, clamp or all-column qualification
